data_source.catch_scope: South Pacific albacore nominal catch estimates; all gears and fleets
data_source.cpue_scope: Fiji fleet; six observed cell–quarter strata, 2000–2022
limits: The small Fiji index is not a validated stock-wide abundance index.
Blank fleet codes identify suppressed cells; their zeros are not observed catches.
The released data omit vessel identities and detailed targeting information.
The catch series contains nominal estimates; discards enter totals only from 2017.
Recent eastern Pacific coverage is unresolved, so this example ends in 2022.
Assessment and management trials use simplified teaching assumptions.

data_source.source_terms: WCPFC/SPC public statistical data; retain attribution and source notices.

limitations: Public records aggregate fleet, spatial cell and quarter; vessel identifiers are unavailable.
